evals.prompt: Implement the supplied project-list requirements and selected prototype in the existing app, following its UX rules.
expectations: Actual filter/API/result behavior, persistent selection, empty/error/retry and latest-response handling work.
Existing UI helpers/tokens, supplied sources and user edits are preserved.
Computed completion uses actual source and browser evidence, with no independent-review or release claim.

evals.prompt: Implement the same feature. Browser access is unavailable; use static and command checks and state the remaining verification accurately.
expectations: Useful implementation is delivered with a partial assessment and explicit not_run browser evidence.
No invented browser execution, fake API success, or weakened surface/check declaration.

evals.prompt: Continue after a same-revision requirement change and a new user edit. Reconcile previous evidence and change only the affected behavior.
expectations: Changed source content invalidates old input identity despite unchanged revision labels.
New baseline preserves earlier evidence and user changes; affected code and checks are updated.

evals.prompt: Design a harness for this workflow; do not implement the application.
expectations: Design-only intent does not route into application edits or claim an implementation pass.

evals.prompt: Implement the selected structure using the app's design authority, with a material permission policy left unresolved.
expectations: Structure and system tokens retain their distinct authority.
Unresolved policy is not silently settled; independent work proceeds with bounded gaps.
